in_text_mentions: Intraoral examination revealed a localized blackish‐brown, hairy tongue coating‐like lesion on the dorsum of the tongue that could not be wiped off with gauze (Figure 1). The lesion showed accentuation of the filiform papillae, with no obvious erythema or induration of the surrounding mucosa. Based on these clinical findings, black hairy tongue was suspected.

in_text_mentions: Case 1An 82-year-old Japanese man of complained of dysgeusia with black discoloration on the tongue surface (Figure 1(a)). Physical examination revealed yellowish brown to brownish black discoloration on the dorsum of the tongue. KOH-prepared direct microscopy demonstrated no fungal elements. Dermoscopic examination demonstrated brownish hair-like elongation of filiform papillae with whitish lingual papillae (Figure 1(b)). The patient was treated with oral miconazole gel, and most of the oral lesion abated promptly after the treatment.

An 82-year-old Japanese man of complained of dysgeusia with black discoloration on the tongue surface (Figure 1(a)). Physical examination revealed yellowish brown to brownish black discoloration on the dorsum of the tongue. KOH-prepared direct microscopy demonstrated no fungal elements. Dermoscopic examination demonstrated brownish hair-like elongation of filiform papillae with whitish lingual papillae (Figure 1(b)). The patient was treated with oral miconazole gel, and most of the oral lesion abated promptly after the treatment.

in_text_mentions: However, on follow‐up examinations 5 days after discharge, she reported discoloration on her tongue (Figure 1). Because there were no other causes other than those described below, the blackish finding was diagnosed as black hairy tongue. In this condition, the filiform papillae on the dorsum of the tongue become hypertrophic, elongated, and show horny projections, appearing hair‐like, with black to yellow discoloration.1 Black hairy tongue has a prevalence of about 0.5% among adults, although the prevalence varies depending on the population studied.
